definitions: A mass meeting of people making a political protest or showing support for a cause.
A an improvement in the price or value of something after a period of decline.
A long-distance competition for cars or motorcycles over public roads or rough terrain.
An act of hitting the ball back and forth in tennis or similar games.
examples: A rally was held in Trafalgar Square.
The market saw a late rally.
He competed in the Monte Carlo Rally.
The rally lasted for several minutes.
